brand.name: Victory Skating Academy
brand.description: Online figure skating academy running live group training programs for skaters worldwide.

programs.name: 6-Month Double Axel Club
programs.summary: Online 6-month double axel training program by Victory Skating Academy (VSA). 48 live group classes, 2 every weekend (Saturday and Sunday), $299 for the whole program.
programs.description: A six-month online group program for skaters moving from double jumps to the double axel. Live coaching every weekend covers technique, rotational speed, power and explosiveness, with structured progression across the full six months and a path into triple jumps afterwards.

instructors.name: Coach Marta
instructors.bio: Figure skating coach with international experience as both a skater and a coach, trained in Poland and Finland.

programs.audience: Figure skaters who have already landed double jumps off-ice and are working toward a double axel, and who want structured coaching toward triple jumps.
includes: 2 free guest passes for group classes
Invitation to the Triple Jumps Club at the same flat fee after completion
socialProof: Over 800 skaters have landed their double axel with the program, many within 12 weeks
